blockers.detail: Fresh primary evidence materially reduced prior unknowns: Q2 2026 revenue was $3.33B (+12% YoY), FY2026 revenue guidance was raised to $13.1-$13.2B, cash/marketable securities were $13.6B at June 30, and the Crinetics acquisition closed September 1, 2026. Current market evidence established a September 25 close of $526.19 and approximately $133.4B market capitalization. These facts improve financial momentum, catalyst, diversification and valuation context, but the run did not establish sufficiently source-addressed evidence for every required Methodology 1.0 component, especially governance, supply-chain resilience, bottleneck control and durable pricing power; no numeric score was manufactured.

sourcePathsAttempted: Vertex September 1 2026 Crinetics acquisition completion release
learning.failedStrategy: Existing cumulative evidence alone lacked current operating, transaction-close and valuation facts needed for calibrated scoring.
learning.changedStrategy: Added fresh issuer operating/acquisition-close evidence and an independent current market valuation source rather than repeating the stale cumulative-evidence inspection.
learning.nextLawfulAction: Acquire current proxy/governance evidence plus source-addressed evidence for supply-chain resilience, bottleneck control and pricing power; then calibrate all 12 components under methodology-1.0.0-calibration-a.
